paite: Kei hon deih ngeiloute zon in ka om; hon zong ngeiloute muhkhiak in ka om; ka min pu lou nam kiang ah, "Hon en un, hon en un," ka chi hi.
heading: Pathian In Helhatte A Gawtna
english: “I am inquired of by those who didn’t ask; I am found by those who didn’t seek me: I said, See me, see me, to a nation that was not called by my name.

paite: Mihelhatte a ding in nitum in ka bante ka zak, huaite bel amau ngaihtuahnate bang zel a lampi hoih lou a paite ahi.
english: I have spread out my hands all the day to a rebellious people, who walk in a way that is not good, after their own thoughts;

paite: Huante a kithoih a, teklei tungte a banghiam gimlim hal a, ka maitang mahmah a hon hihheh nakte.
english: a people who provoke me to my face continually, sacrificing in gardens, and burning incense on bricks;

paite: Han lakte khawng a tu a, mundaite a giak a, voksa ne a, abelte ua thilkihhuai tuihuante.
english: who sit among the graves, and lodge in the secret places; who eat pig’s flesh, and broth of abominable things is in their vessels;

paite: Nang kia dingh in, hon naih ke'n, nang sang in ka siangthouzaw hi, chite ahi uh; huaite bel ka nak a meikhu om, nitum a mei mit lou om gige nakte ahi uhi.
english: who say, Stand by yourself, don’t come near to me, for I am holier than you. These are a smoke in my nose, a fire that burns all the day.

paite: Ngai in, ka ma ah gelh in a-om; ka dai nilouh kei ding a, ka thuk ding, a-angsung uah ka thuk ding.
english: “Behold, it is written before me: I will not keep silence, but will recompense, yes, I will recompense into their bosom,

paite: Noumau thulimlouhna leh na pute uh thulimlouhnate, TOUPA'N achi, huaite'n lah tangte tung ah gimlim ahal ua, mual tungte ah ka min agensia uhi; huaiziak in anasep uh amasapen in a-angsung uah ka tehsak ding hi.
english: your own iniquities, and the iniquities of your fathers together,” says Yahweh, “who have burned incense on the mountains, and blasphemed me on the hills; therefore will I first measure their work into their bosom.”

paite: TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Grep bawm ah uain thak amu ua, mi'n, 'Hihse ke'n, huai ah lah vualzawlna a-om ngal a,' achih bang un, ka sikhate ziak in ka hih sam ding, avek ua ka suksiatlouhna ding in.
english: Thus says Yahweh, “As the new wine is found in the cluster, and one says, ‘Don’t destroy it, for a blessing is in it:’ so will I do for my servants’ sake, that I may not destroy them all.

paite: Huan Jakob a kipan in chi khat ka pawtsak ding a, Judah a kipan in ka tangte luah ding ka pawtsak ding; huchi in ka mitelte'n huai aluah ding ua, ka sikhate huai ah a-om ding uh.
english: I will bring forth a seed out of Jacob, and out of Judah an inheritor of my mountains; and my chosen shall inherit it, and my servants shall dwell there.

paite: Huan ka mi, kei hon zongte a ding in, Sharon belamhonte huang ahi ding a, Akor Phaizang bel bawnghon kualna mun ahi ding hi.
english: Sharon shall be a fold of flocks, and the valley of Achor a place for herds to lie down in, for my people who have sought me.

paite: "Himahleh nou TOUPA paisan a, ka tang siangthou mangngilh a, Gad pathian a ding a dohkan bawl a, Meni a ding a dawn thillat lante aw;
english: “But you who forsake Yahweh, who forget my holy mountain, who prepare a table for Fortune, and who fill up mixed wine to Destiny;

paite: k'on sap lai in na hon dawng nuam kei ua, thu ka gen lai in na za ut kei ua, ka mitmuh in thil gilou na hih zaw ua, ka kipahpih louh thil na tel zawk ziak un namsau in na tan hun uh ka hon ngaihtuahsak ding a, na vek un thahna ah na kun vek ding uh.
english: I will destine you to the sword, and you shall all bow down to the slaughter; because when I called, you didn’t answer; when I spoke, you didn’t listen; but you did that which was evil in my eyes, and chose that in which I didn’t delight.”

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, 'Ngai un, ka sikhate'n ane ding ua, nou bel gilkial in na om ding ua; ngai un, ka sikhate'n adawn ding ua, nou bel dangtak in na om ding uh; ngai un, ka sikhate'n nuam asa ding ua, nou bel na zum ding uh;
english: Therefore thus says the Lord Yahweh, “Behold, my servants shall eat, but you shall be hungry; behold, my servants shall drink, but you shall be thirsty; behold, my servants shall rejoice, but you shall be disappointed;

paite: ngai un, ka sikhate lungtang akipah ziak un la asa ding ua, nou bel lungtang a na lungkham ziak un na kap ding uh, kha a na vui ziak un na mau vungvung ding uh.
english: behold, my servants shall sing for joy of heart, but you shall cry for sorrow of heart, and shall wail for anguish of spirit.

paite: Huan hamsia hi ding in ka mitelte kiang ah na min uh na nuse ding ua, Toupa PATHIAN in ahon that ding hi; huan, asikhate min dang in asamta ding hi.
english: You shall leave your name for a curse to my chosen; and the Lord Yahweh will kill you; and he will call his servants by another name:

paite: Huchi in lei a amah kivualzawl tawmmi bel thutak Pathian ah akivualzawl ding a; lei a kichiammi in thutak Pathian lou in akichiam ding; nidang alungkhamnate mangngilh a a-om tak ziak in leh ka mit a kipan a sel a a-om tak ziakin.'
english: so that he who blesses himself in the earth shall bless himself in the God of truth; and he who swears in the earth shall swear by the God of truth; because the former troubles are forgotten, and because they are hidden from my eyes.

paite: "Ngai un, van thakte leh lei thak ka siam ahi; nidanglai thilte zaw theihgige in a-om nawn kei ding a, lungsim ah leng alut nawn kei ding hi.
heading: Thilsiam Thak
english: “For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth; and the former things shall not be remembered, nor come into mind.

paite: Himahleh ka thilsiam ah tangtawn in kipak in nuamsa un; ngai un, Jerusalem nopsakna ding in ka siam a, amite kipahna ding in ka bawl hi.
english: But be you glad and rejoice forever in that which I create; for, behold, I create Jerusalem a rejoicing, and her people a joy.

paite: Jerusalem tung ah nuam ka sa ding a, ka mite tung ah leng ka kipak ding; asung ah kap husa zak ahi nawn kei ding a, mau husa leng zak ahi nawn kei ding hi.
english: I will rejoice in Jerusalem, and joy in my people; and there shall be heard in her no more the voice of weeping and the voice of crying.

paite: Huai a kipan a pawt zaw naungek ni sawt louchik dam a-om kei ding ua, putek adamsung nite tangtun lou leng a-om kei ding uh; naupang lah kum za a upa in asi ding ua, mikhial kum za lel dam zaw hamsethuak ahi ding uhi.
english: “There shall be no more there an infant of days, nor an old man who has not filled his days; for the child shall die one hundred years old, and the sinner being one hundred years old shall be accursed.

paite: Huan innte alam ding ua, huaite ah a-om gige ding uh; grephuan abawl ding ua, agah leng ane ding uh.
english: They shall build houses, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and eat their fruit.

paite: Midang omna ding in inn alam nawn kei ding ua, midang nek ding in grephuan abawl nawn kei ding uh; sing damsung nite bang in ka mite damsung nite lah om ding ahi ngal a, ka mitelte zaw sawtpi asepkhiak tung uah akipak ding uhi.
english: They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree shall be the days of my people, and my chosen shall long enjoy the work of their hands.

paite: Bangmah lou in asemgim kei ding ua, vangtah lel ding in ta anei sam kei ding uh; TOUPA vualzawlmi suante ahi ngal ua, atate uh akiang uah a-om nilouh ding uh.
english: They shall not labor in vain, nor bring forth for calamity; for they are the seed of the blessed of Yahweh, and their offspring with them.

paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, amau hon sap ma un ka dawng ding a; thu agen san lai un leng ka bil in ka za ding hi.
english: It shall happen that, before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.

paite: Ngia leh belamnou agamtakhawm ding ua, humpinelkai in bawngtal bang in buhpawl ane ding a; gulpi an leivui ahi ding hi. Ka tang siangthou ah akihih na nawn kei ding ua, akihihse nawn sam kei ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
english: The wolf and the lamb shall feed together, and the lion shall eat straw like the ox; and dust shall be the serpent’s food. They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain,” says Yahweh.
